scientific_integrity: Arithmetic cutoff is proven by an exact index-set bijection, and a standalone integer-only program exhaustively checks all finite possibilities; computations are not used to infer unbounded cases.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite classification only through exponent 27; no claim of nonexistence of three-pair cases for larger exponents or infinitude of four-pair cases. Public close antecedent full text not accessible for a whole-document comparison.
title: The first four omitted divisor pairs on \(2^a p\): an exact finite classification
